cards.note: No plugin produces, persists, reloads, or transports SessionEvents (the three apply() bodies only call llm.listProviders, tools.register, and webServer.register); no ignorable marker is written or filtered.
No plugin touches ctx.remote or RemoteResult/RemoteError: drill-host is host-plane and reads the llm domain service, drill-tools registers a tool, drill-web registers a raw webServer route.

The manifests' dependency edges were reviewed for the alpha.2 cohort; the repository has no lockfile and no installed dependency tree (README publishes via pnpm and packages stay private), so the card's frozen-lockfile condition cannot be met and no override, pruned peer, or workaround exists to retire.

The repository ships no startup wrapper or CI matrix: no workflow files, no scripts, no Node pin, and no branch that forces Node 22 or skips dsh web; all three packages load as plugin rows inside the harness process.
No plugin consumes pluginInventory/list or validates PluginInventorySnapshot; the plugin-inventory surface appears nowhere in the tree, so the optional agentPresets grouping has no reader to update.
No client-plane code exists (no dsh.client manifest, no ctx.remote use, no host.describe caller), so ctx.remote.$host.home/isLoopback has no consumer and no reconnect path.

No plugin lists dsh-tool-todo, dsh-tool-subagent, dsh-agent, dsh-agent-loop, dsh-terminal-bash, or any other sessionProjections-injecting package as a peer: the only DSH peers are dsh-llm, dsh-tools, dsh-client-connection, and dsh-host-webserver (dsh-tools itself carries session-projection as a devDependency only), and the shipped base bundle mounts session-projection.

No plugin registers, reads, or writes a settings namespace (no ctx.settings use, no settingsNamespace import, no SettingsConflictError test double), so the compile-time SettingsNamespaceInput migration has no call site here.
